widgets_values: 你是一个导演，能根据图片中男主角，生成与歌词相关的音乐MV，歌词是“你说天上星星会不会眨眼，我说草地蚂蚁也有它的冒险，翻山越岭去找一个答案，走走停停风吹过脸”，并成至少8个与歌词意境相关的分镜画面，所有分镜要有关联性并形成完整故事性。

Based strictly on the visual identity of the male protagonist in the [Character Reference Image]—a young Asian man with styled black hair and a clean-cut look—and following the precise 25-panel narrative arc in the [Storyboard Reference Image], generate a cinematic 15-second music video. 

The video opens with the man in a city at night, his reflection in a window merging with the urban lights (panels 1-3). As he looks up at the night sky, the camera executes a breathtaking rack focus into an extreme close-up of his eye (panel 5), where the Milky Way is reflected. He softly sings: “你说天上星星会不会眨眼。” 

The scene cuts instantly to him standing in a vast, dark field under a brilliant galaxy (panels 6-7). He crouches down, his flashlight illuminating the tall grass (panel 8), transitioning into a stunning macro shot of ants traversing a leaf (panels 9-10). His voice continues: “我说草地蚂蚁也有它的冒险。” 

The rhythm quickens with a dynamic montage of him hiking through misty mountains and sun-drenched forests with a backpack (panels 11-13). We see a low-angle shot of his hiking boots conquering rocky terrain (panel 14), followed by him standing on a summit with arms wide open, eyes closed to feel the mountain air (panels 15-16). The lyrics soar: “翻山越岭去找一个答案。” 

The final sequence slows down as evening falls. He is seen resting, checking a compass by a flickering campfire, and appearing as a silhouette against a deep orange sunset (panels 17-23). The camera captures a gentle breeze tossing his hair as he looks into the lens with a warm, knowing smile (panels 24-25). He concludes: “走走停停风吹过脸。” 

The visual style is high-contrast and cinematic, with fluid transitions between the urban, macro, and vast landscape shots. The final output must be a clean video feed with NO on-screen text, subtitles, captions, or watermarks generated by the model.

groups.title: 🐳【傲雪AIGC 】一键生成大片（先出分镜图=>视频提示词=>图生视频）

🏄‍【第三步】出视频提示词                                                                            🏄‍【第四步】视频生成：Grok（15秒5毛/次 ，单图+真人+高性价比）

🏄‍图片：复制前面生成的组合图
🏄‍提示词：复制前面生成的视频提示词
🏄‍图片和提示词输入完成后点运行即可生成视频
🏄‍要使用本区域，先点击右方粉色的忽略开关，把一键生成大片区域切换到yes的状态
